frequency_question: How often do countries successfully negotiate and sign a renewal or successor water treaty before the prior long-term treaty expires?
membership_rule: Includes major international water treaties with fixed multi-decade terms between neighboring countries; excludes minor domestic water use pacts or non-treaty informal understandings.
window: Within the final 5 years prior to expiration
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named historical major transboundary water treaty precedents; believed to represent standard practice for vital resource treaties.
known_gaps: Does not account for severe diplomatic freezes that completely halt technical committee talks.
skeleton: 5 major international transboundary water treaty renewal cycles evaluated
validity_reason: State practice regarding vital transboundary water resources changes slowly over decades.
